name: HB-2 best-of-n cap1 partial baseline
purpose: Start HB-2 external/no-train baseline evaluation by implementing the allowed direct best-of-n parallel sampling BudgetRunner and running a fast B*-only n=64 cap1 lower-bound pilot on sudoku, futoshiki, and graph_color. This validates the shared official scoring/token-billing harness but does not complete HB-2 because cap1 does not exhaust the available B* budgets and LFS/ToT/RAP ports are still pending.

provenance.spec: user CODING SPEC — HB-2 External No-Train Matched-Budget Comparison (v0)

code_added_used.change: Implements the best-of-n direct no-train BudgetRunner with shared tokenizer billing, official score_answer scoring, sharding, checkpointing, and merging.
Runs B*-only n=64 best-of-n cap1 shards across 8 GPUs and merges results.

commands.purpose: Run best-of-n direct baseline at each task's B* with max_samples_per_budget=1 and n=64.

headline.best_of_n: With max_samples_per_budget=1, best-of-n solved 0/64 on sudoku, futoshiki, and graph_color at B*; all rows ended ATTEMPT_CAP, so this is a lower-bound smoke rather than a budget-exhaustive baseline.
headline.A_vs_cap1: Existing A_cache lines beat this cap1 baseline on all three tasks, but HB-2 is not confirmed because the located no-train baseline set is not complete and best-of-n was intentionally capped.
headline.single_next_move: Run a budget-exhaustive or larger-cap best-of-n curve and then port LFS/ToT/RAP through the same BudgetRunner before reading HB-2.

gate_outcomes.number: n=64 per task, official score_answer, shared token counter, sharded/merged artifact present.
cap1 best-of-n is not budget-exhaustive and LFS/ToT/RAP are not ported/run.

decision.next_step_routing: Keep HB-2 open. Use this runner for larger best-of-n caps/sweeps; implement LFS and LLM-reasoners ToT/RAP ports with repo provenance before final HB-2 confirm/kill.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not complete HB-2 and does not establish superiority over the no-train frontier. It only validates the direct best-of-n runner and records a cap1 lower-bound baseline.
honesty.cap_limit: max_samples_per_budget=1 intentionally leaves most of each B* unused, so the zero solve rates are not a final best-of-n result.
honesty.external_limit: LFS, ToT, RAP, and First Finish ports are still not run; Beyond-the-Frontier remains final-not-run due to no official repo.
